warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, funding, backing, liquidity, financial safety, legal eligibility, successful execution or a complete workflow. Ember Earn Ethereum USDC vault only: current ERC1967 proxy implementation observed as 0x9b2e2eef7ffe1b15ca8c61e65538b51ca8977c7e at block 0x190b3f9. Proxy source is explorer similar-match, implementation source exact-match; neither is an ongoing runtime or dependency-safety guarantee. No Sui execution or bridge operation is admitted.

USDC assets and eEARN shares use 6 decimals. The administrator-updated 1e18 rate is inverse asset/share pricing: deposits floor assets*rate/1e18; exact-share mint rounds assets up. No caller slippage minimum or deadline is present in the selected plain methods. Reported yield and NAV may decline and are not verified backing.

Deposits pull only caller-approved USDC and mint shares to a fixed financial receiver; subaccounts and blacklisted parties are excluded. A mutable vault validator can impose eligibility, allowlists and other checks. parkingLot was zero and vault/protocol pause reads were false at the observed block, not a future availability promise; no roles, allowance or eligibility are granted.

redeemShares takes caller shares into vault escrow using preexisting share allowance to the vault; it creates a FIFO request, not an immediate USDC payment. The observed minimum is 100000 share atoms (0.1 eEARN). Operator processing burns shares and pays the chosen nonzero receiver at the processing-time rate, less validator permanent/time-based fees. API currently advertises three days but source imposes no guaranteed servicing deadline.

Cancellation only marks the caller-owned pending sequence number; escrowed shares return when the operator processes the cancelled request, not immediately. Blacklisted/zero-proceeds requests may also be skipped and returned. The operator can move collateral to approved managed subaccounts; offchain/crosschain strategy custody, mutable config/validator fees, credit/market losses and available collateral affect redemption. No backing, principal or execution guarantee is made.
